outs: seed anchor reader: a seed's face name is provably free at HEAD and in the working tree (R2259)
on

R2259: src/os/seed_anchor.py turns the hand-run git grep into a reading. The HEAD scope answers what a landed seed would collide with; the working-tree scope (git grep --untracked) answers what a sibling window that wrote but did not commit would collide with, so an uncommitted edit and an untracked file both count. Every hit carries needle, scope, file and line, the FREE/OCCUPIED verdict reconciles against head/tree/per-needle counts, --limit bounds the detail with an honest truncated flag, and any hit refuses to seed (E_SAN_OCCUPIED, CLI 2 with REFUSE TO SEED) while FREE exits 0, bad flags 2 and a non-repository or git failure 3. GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES is pinned to the parent of the scanned root so a plain directory cannot borrow an enclosing repository. Criteria AC-SAN1..AC-SAN5 were pinned in state/queue/tech.md as the R2248 e seed BEFORE the code, with a zero-occupancy anchor check at HEAD (os-seed-anchor / test_seed_anchor / E_SAN rc=1). Evidence: SUITE PASS 5/5 double-run byte-identical criterion sha16 42FAF3CADB8BEEF9 (qa/seed-anchor-R2259-a.log and -b.log, 429B each, single writer utf-8 LF through src/os/evidence_R2259.py), five adjacent os suites green (qa/regression-R2259.log, fails=0), wired os-seed-anchor(5). Live: seed_anchor OCCUPIED head=31 tree=52 (text occupancy, disclosed) while the fresh label os-seed-anchor reads FREE at HEAD and only becomes occupied in the working tree. Honest defect: the first HEAD leg put the revision before the pattern, git consumed HEAD as the needle, and every HEAD scan read zero - fixed in the module with an explicit -e, no criterion relaxed.

export freshness gate: the CEO-visible face is now judged on time as well as shape (R2250)
on

R2250: docs/status-export.json is the only surface the CEO reads, and the round book requires three lines with the next milestone inside 48h, but every existing check was about shape and derivation - a perfectly shaped face two days old passed, and so did a milestone announced three weeks out. src/os/export_freshness.py measures only the missing axis: the age of the face against a 24h freshness gate and the announced milestone against a 48h window, with the clock injected by the caller so a reading is reproducible and testable. Verdicts are four and exhaustive (FRESH / STALE-FACE / STALE-WINDOW / UNVERIFIABLE-WINDOW); a face that publishes no next_milestone_due reads as an honest unknown on its own exit code (4) rather than as a fabricated pass, and a stamp without a UTC offset is refused (E_EXP_BAD_TS) instead of being assumed local, because the face is written by different writers across the day. Shape and derivation stay with check_export_consistency, which was re-run green after the change, so this window added no second wheel. Evidence: SUITE PASS 6/6 double-run byte-identical criterion sha16 6B9DC44593508471 (qa/export-freshness-R2250-a.log / -b.log, 466B each, single writer utf-8 LF), five adjacent os suites green (qa/regression-R2250.log, 4878B), wired os-export-freshness(6). The live reading at the R2249 face was verdict=UNVERIFIABLE-WINDOW age=0.3h; this window's refresh publishes next_milestone_due so the gate now reads FRESH.

state fold as one callable (state_fold.py) - waterline, verbatim window, append-only archive

R2245: the state.json log fold was a hand-run surgical habit - the window was picked by counting lines, the waterline was eyeballed, and the archive append was a bespoke script each time, so every fold was another chance to cut a round line in half or to rewrite the archive instead of appending to it. src/os/state_fold.py owns the three decisions once. measure(disk_bytes) returns the waterline verdict from the real disk size (bytes, gate, margin, fold_needed, verdict in the closed set FOLD-CLEAR/FOLD-DUE, with 78500 exactly at the gate reading clear). plan_fold(raw, state, w1, w2, summary) is the fold predicate and writes nothing: it reports the window line count and content bytes, proves every PAT token in the window appears in the summary, predicts the post-fold disk size, and builds the exact prefix+[summary]+suffix splice on the canonical 16-space CRLF layout, refusing a file whose item lines do not match its parsed log length (E_SF_BAD_LAYOUT), an out-of-bounds window (E_SF_WINDOW) and a multi-line summary instead of guessing. append_archive(path, header, lines) appends the header plus the window lines verbatim, proves the old bytes are a strict prefix of the new bytes, repairs a missing trailing newline, creates the archive only under allow_create with a preamble, and verifies the read-back. fold(root, ...) is the single callable that plans, writes a byte-identical backup (read back), appends the archive, atomically replaces state.json, and then proves post bytes == predicted bytes and the new log == prefix+[summary]+suffix. check(root) is the read-only --check report (exit 0 clear / 2 due or bad flags / 3 unreadable) and writes nothing at all.
